interpretation.solubility: Predicted LogS is reported in log10(mol/L).
interpretation.condition_scores: Condition scores are ranking scores, not calibrated probabilities.
interpretation.retrieval_similarity: RXNFP cosine similarity is not a probability of reaction success.
interpretation.historical_response: ORD LC area percent at 280 nm is not isolated reaction yield.
interpretation.synthesizability: The reported synthesis risk is a lightweight assessment, not multi-step retrosynthesis.
